dataList.content:
All right, how did this happen?
嗯，再从头梳理一遍吧。

First, we boarded the WARP train to get to our next destination, P Corp...
我们为了前往下一个目的地——P公司，而乘坐了WARP列车……

Got into our fancy first class flash-freeze hibernation capsules, and...
进入了头等舱的冬眠胶囊舱里……

... we were supposed to arrive at P Corp. after a quick blink of an eye, but...
眨眼之间就到了P公司，事情本来应该是这样发展的……

Dante, please respond. There's—
但丁，听得到吗？现在……

The first thing I saw when my vision returned was the perplexed look on Faust,
who had entered hibernation at the same time as I did...
视野恢复后，我看到本应一起进入冬眠的浮士德正用不知所措的眼神注视着我……

... then I realized that we woke up mid-transit on the WARP train...
我意识到WARP列车还在运行中，而我们正处于被丢在了不知何处的次元空间里……

... which could only mean that we're now stranded in some lost, unknown dimension...?
的情况……当中？

Dante, I understand your considerable degree of disorientation, but—
但丁，我知道你现在很混乱……

What...
为什么……

<... What the hell happened?>
<……为什么，事情会变成这样啊？>

First things first...
首先……

... let's rewind and return to the very start of this highly unfavorable situation we find ourselves in.
……让我们将时光倒流，回到这起令人头痛的事件的开端。

A few days ago...
几天前……

Our next destination... is to a WARP train, Dante.
下一个目的地……是WARP列车，但丁。
dataList.place:
Aboard Mephistopheles
梅菲斯托费勒斯 内部

dataList.content:
Yep. That's where it all started.
是的，全部都是从这里开始的。

There I was, still perplexed by the incidents at T Corp., with my awful idea of clearing the air by asking Vergilius for our next destination. Not knowing the storm that my innocent question would bring.
在T公司发生的事件的热度尚未消散前……我为了转换气氛而抛出的关于下个目的地的问题，成为了一切的开端。

V-v-v-v-v-verily, I must have misheard!?
吾吾吾吾吾……吾没听错吧！？

I'm quite certain you didn't, Don Quixote.
我确信你听得一清二楚，堂吉诃德。

We are now en route to the T Corp. WARP train station.
你们现在将要前往T公司的WARP列车车站。
That whuh-WARP train station must have some conundrum that must be resolved there, indeed? A-a quest that must be swiftly addressed at the station, yes? WA！WARP列车车站一定是出了什么问题吧！吾等的任务，肯定就是前去解决那个问题吧！

Did a Distortion pop up at one of the WARP platforms or something?
难道是WARP列车车站出现扭曲了？

I see that you are now significantly less disinclined to take on some side jobs. But no.
看来你们已经不再抵触做些副业了呢。不过，并不是那样。

We are boarding the WARP train to get to P Corp., end of story. There's nothing between the lines, so don't try reading into it.
为了前往P公司，我们要乘坐WARP列车。字面意思。

It was only natural that the Sinners immediately fell into a state of collective dumbfounded shock. 
所有罪人都很震惊，不过这也在情理之中。

None of the Sinners have any history of working at W Corp., but...
虽说并没有罪人曾经在W公司任职过，但……

<We're... actually taking that train?>
<我们真的……要乘坐那辆列车吗？>

... through what vague information we could gather from the Identities, we all had some fragmentary knowledge about the terrible secrets of the WARP trains' operations.
通过人格所得知的信息，能让我们在某种程度上了解到WARP列车的运行方式。

I initially considered hiding this information from the rest of the Sinners, but since sharing things with everyone and letting them get their two cents in usually ended up being pretty helpful, I've been sharing more of these as of late.
起初我打算对罪人们隐瞒这些信息，但是……我认为还是将信息分享出来，并让大家发表自己的意见和看法会更有帮助，于是我决定分享一部分我与人格间的对话。

Though I have very dim, if present at all, recollections from the time during which I wear the Identities...
关于使用人格时的记忆，与其说是模糊不清，不如说是几乎没有了……

Mm. It can be determined from the conversational records between the Manager and the Identities that the mechanisms behind WARP trains' operations can be deemed as somewhat bizarre and inefficient.
嗯。从经理和人格之间的对话记录来看，WARP列车的原理确实多少有些低效且怪异。

Ohh~ Yeah! It's that 10-second trip that actually takes a long, long time~ Right? And when the train reaches the destination, they just wipe the passengers' memories?
啊~说是十秒就能到达，但实际上要运行很~长的时间，然后会把乘客的记忆全部清除掉对吗？

I-I also heard that the passengers get so weary of boredom that they start literally ripping and tearing into one another...
我、我还听说乘客之间会互相撕裂和破坏。因为他们没法忍耐无聊……

Sounds like I might finally have a chance to see a masterpiece with my own eyes.
听起来我可以久违地欣赏到一幅杰作了。

Even when the Sinners wear the Identities through my Identity Cards, the Identities' memories or beliefs don't bleed into them once it's over and done with.
尽管通过人格卡能让罪人们使用他们的人格，但该人格的记忆、思想、或是信仰并不会转移给罪人。

I remember when Faust explained that, due to the risks associated with embracing such influences, there was a filtering process to intentionally block them from reaching the Sinners.
有一次，浮士德谈到有关此事的危险性时，说过会采取一系列步骤来预防和过滤此类危险。

That's why the Sinners could use the Identities of some of our worst enemies without getting infected by their philosophies and whatnot...
多亏于此，即使使用了曾经将我们置于危险境地的强大敌人的人格，罪人们也并没有受到他们的影响而被转变……

... but it also meant that they couldn't retain any new information that each Identity had to offer. That's why I keep a record of some things that sound particularly important and sometimes share it with the rest of the Sinners.
相对的，罪人们无法记下从人格中获取的新情报这件事，某种意义上来说会有些遗憾，因此我会将重要的信息记录下来，并经常与罪人们分享。

<My "voice" doesn't really carry well past the window, so most of our communications are one-sided. But...>
<因为我的声音无法很好地透过玻璃窗传达出去，所以几乎都是我在单方面地听那边说的话……>

... I had an abundance of W Corp. Identities, so it wasn't difficult to piece together the truth behind the trains.
不过很多罪人都拥有W公司的人格，因此收集相关信息并不难。

But... Um...
但是……嗯……

Maybe ignorance really is bliss...
也许对所有人来说，在这点上真的无知是福吧……

Your collective agitation and possible incompliance have already been anticipated.
大家对此所产生的种种动摇与反对，已在预料当中。

Lady Faust?! Then thou hast known this all along?! Wherefore hast thou not deigned to tell me of this?!
浮士德小姐？！汝早已知晓此事了吗？！为何不预先告诉吾呢！

Faust has indeed known this all along, as no knowledge is out of Faust's reach. Naturally, a solution to your dilemma has already been prepared.
因为浮士德无所不知。当然，大家提出的问题也已经准备好解决方案了。
I seriously doubt your solution involves not getting on the train, so what is it? 无法改变要乘坐列车的事实，又有什么办法可取呢？

The bus... oh, what about this bus? There's no way this thing fits inside a train car!
巴士、这辆巴士该怎么办？！没办法把巴士塞进列车里吧！

Charon vetoes, too. No one to feed Mephi when Charon's gone. 
卡戎也反对。不乘梅菲乘坐别的，谁来给梅菲喂饭呢。

... Miss Faust.
……浮士德女士。

The rearmost tail cars of WARP trains are all freight cars. That is where Mephistopheles will be safely fastened and transported.
WARP列车的车尾有货运车厢。梅菲斯托费勒斯会被固定在该车厢内，随我们共同移动。

And the LCB will...
同时，LCB所属人员……

... have the benefit of boarding as first class passengers.
将乘坐头等舱进行移动。

The bus begins to swell with noise again, though in a slightly different air to the alarmed response from earlier.
随着浮士德的发言，巴士中又弥漫开来一股不同于先前的气氛。

First class passengers...? What, the seats for those pompous toffs?
头等舱似乎只给有钱人坐吧，不是吗？

Even on normal trains, you've got those sods whose proudest accomplishment in life is planting their arses in first class seats, while others are cramming themselves into freight cars because they haven't the cash for even an economy ticket...
就算是普通列车上也会有坐在头等舱里洋洋得意的人，而其他人有的甚至挤在货运车厢里，因为他们连买一张经济舱车票的钱都没有……

W-why are you glaring at me like that...? I've never been in one of those first class seats before either...
为、为什么盯着我看……？我从来没坐过头等舱……

Isn't the ticket for a single first class seat like, as expensive as three or four months' salary of a first-year Wing employee? Can our budget really handle getting a ticket for us each?
我听说头等舱的票价抵得上一个翼员工三四个月的起薪……咱们公司的财务真的不会出问题吗？

The company's budget is not a subject that warrants your concern.
无需担忧公司的财务状况。

I heard first class passengers get some cool bonus stuff like... personalized private capsules or something, don't they?
私人胶囊舱……这词用得还挺花哨，我听说头等舱会为每个乘客都提供这种席位……

That is the promotional language, yes. They are flash-freeze hibernation capsules, to be precise.
那是宣传中包含的描述。严格来说，应该称其为急速冬眠胶囊舱。

They have been designed to easily withstand the "true" amount of time it takes for the WARP train to travel from point A to point B. Passengers will feel as though the trip is over in the blink of an eye.
因为WARP列车在设计上使得乘客可以轻松承受住“实际上”移动所花费的时间，所以他们可以获得眨眼之间就能到达目的地的体验。

The company's regard for our well-being is unfamiliar yet welcome. To be provided such extravagance merely for our comfort... such occurrence is quite seldom.
非常感谢公司的深厚关怀。为了让我们不受舟车劳顿之苦，斥重金为我们购置了高价的席位……

Right? I honestly thought they were going to slip just the guide and Charon into the first class seats and ship the rest of us in the economy cars.
确实诶，通常的话~我还以为只有向导先生和卡戎会被安排到头等舱里。

Hmph, this seems like an unnecessary luxury. They should have saved their budget and given only the Executive Manager and their loyal advisor access to those seats.
嗯，与其如此大费周章让所有人都入座头等舱，不如只让经理和他最忠实的助手入座才好。

Let's not get ahead of ourselves. We're taking the train to get to our next mission, alright? We have to think about the unique nature of WARP trains and prepare ourselves accordingly.
怎么大家都这么大惊小怪的……我们正要前往下一个任务地点，我们必须得考虑到WARP列车的特殊性，并且做好相应的准备。

Right...?! I know it's first class and all, but WARP trains are just plain creepy. I knew you'd also be worried about—
没错……！以实玛利小姐说得对，就算头等舱再好，WARP列车本身也是个怪异且令人不快的地方，我也很担心……

For example, economy passengers are going to have a hard time getting into a first class car. If they can even attempt to open it, I mean. I'm pretty sure the door separating the cars is ironclad.
值得注意的是，头等舱处在经济舱的乘客无法贸然进入的空间。不，倒不如说他们连头等舱的门都打不开。

Ishmael, who'd been holding that first class promotional pamphlet in her hands for a while, was chattering on with fire in her eyes.
不知何时手握头等舱宣传册的以实玛利眼睛闪闪发光地说道……

We won't even have to lift a finger. We just have to board the train, get into our capsules, shut our eyes, and snooze through the entire ride until all that mess in the other cars blows over. I heard they used to give out commemorative merch back when their finances weren't in the gutter, and—
所以我们乘上列车后，可以与世无争地放松心情闭上眼睛。之前经济情况良好的时候，听说还会发放纪念品……

A true adventure is not without its hardships... Yet... even the most exalted of heroes cannot venture without respite...! And, in very rare occasions, the hero may even deign to select a first class seat to rest in, in place of a quaint inn... Indeed, indeed...
苦难总是常伴冒险旅途……但即使是享有盛名的英雄也需要合上双目休息片刻……！不能总是躺在简陋不堪的旅店里。唔唔……头等舱……

Seems like everyone was at least somewhat interested in the fabled first class seats of WARP trains.
显然，大家都对头等舱充满了好奇心。

I could sense that there was a growing consensus among the Sinners that even a WARP train trip might be acceptable if it meant that they could ride in the first class seats.
如果能乘坐头等舱，那么乘坐WARP列车也没什么大不了，我觉得这种气氛正在逐渐形成。

I will board the train if I must.
要我乘我便乘。

Is first class seating mandatory? I prefer the scenic route. Don't want to miss out on all the fun.
一定要乘坐头等舱吗？在那里就没有鉴赏阿鼻叫唤的乐趣了啊。

Vergilius pretended to not hear Ryōshū's question.
当然，维吉里乌斯忽略了良秀提出的问题。

Very well. Then I assume that we are all in agreement. Let's go.
很好，那就当你们都同意了，出发吧。

Uh...
那个……

I've a matter of great import to discuss with thee...
吾还有一个最重要的问题……

What is it? Out with it, lass. Beatin' around the bush ain't like you.
是什么？支支吾吾的可不像你。

Don Quixote carefully began, almost whispering in a low voice.
堂吉诃德压低自己的声音，小心翼翼地说起来。

That is... in the first class seats...
那个……头等舱的席位……

I have heard tell that we must board with our feet freed from our boots. Doth that claim hold water?
听说要把鞋子脱掉才能入座，当真吗？

... Oh, come on, now. Where did this nonsense gossip come from this time...?
……你是从哪听来这些奇怪的谣言的……

'Tis no gossip! Forsooth, I have overheard aught from those we have walked past ere today, and...
这才不是谣言！吾前些天听到路过的人们的对话……

... When one of them inquired, "You know that you gotta go barefoot in first class, right?" the other responded with: "Of course, man. What am I, stupid?"...
“你知道乘坐头等舱时要光着脚吗？”其中一人这么问，“当然知道啊，你觉得我会不知道吗？”另一人这么回应道……

Doth the traveler speak true, Ishmael?
这是真的吗，以实玛利小姐？

D-don't ask me, I've never been on one of these either.
为、为什么问我……我也没坐过啊……

I don't remember seeing... anything... like that on the pamphlet. Gimme a sec...
宣传册上……好像没有记载这样的内容……请稍等一下。

I mustn't be separated from Rocinante, not even for a twinkle...! I shan't toss Rocinante to the side next to such vulgarities like the ugly shoes of Sir Heathcliff...!
绝对不能让这种事情发生……吾的驽骍难得绝对一刻都不能与吾分开……！吾决不会将吾的驽骍难得放在希斯克利夫先生那丑陋而俗气的鞋子旁……

Oi, you little...!
你这家伙……

I implore thee, O Illustrious Red Gaze...! Prithee, grant me thy permission and allow me to board with Rocinanteeeehhhhhh...?
尊敬的猩红视线老爷，拜托了……就让驽骍难得与吾一同乘坐吧啊啊啊……

I expected Vergilius to answer with his usual exasperated rebuff. Contrary to my expectations, however, he responded in a somewhat serious tone, if tainted by that familiar annoyance.
我本以为维吉里乌斯听到这个问题会像往常一样不耐烦地回应……但他却以相当严肃的语调，并带着“别让我逐一解释这些事”的表情说道。

Fine. Keep your... shoes on.
别脱掉……你的鞋子……
